QuestInfo.name: The Shadowdealer Code
QuestInfo.0: It looks like Gen still has something else he wants to give you a hard time about.
QuestInfo.1: You re-read the#b branch rules#k as a form of punishment.
QuestInfo.2: You read the #bShadowdealer Code#k and passed Gen's test. That's when he noticed the wound on your arm.

0.0: Those who do wrong must be punished.\r\n
0.1: It's time you reaffirmed your commitment to this group by reviewing the #bShadowdealer Code#k. I'm sure you've still got a copy in your inventory. I hope you understood the consequences of your actions.\r\n

yes.0: Read it carefully and think about how your actions reflect on the Shadowdealers.\r\n

0.msg: #b(Read? No way, you have better things to do.)#k\r\n

1.0:
Do you really think you know all there is to being a Shadowdealer? Well then, why don't you tell me the first of our laws.
#L0# #b#rAlways remain proud of your status as a Shadowdealer.#k#l
#L1# Don't fight unless there's profit in it.#l
#k
1.1:
Hmph. That's right. Now, tell me the fourth law.
#L0# #b#rNever do anything for free if you can charge a fee.#k#l
#L1# Infighting between Shadowdealers is prohibited.#l
#k
1.2: That's right, and don't you forget it. Hey, is that blood on your left arm? ...Are you injured?

yes.0: You know I can't stop you. But there will come a day when I've had enough of cleaning up your messes.

default.0: It's time you reaffirmed your commitment to this group by reviewing the #bShadowdealer Code#k. I'm sure you've still got a copy in your inventory. You did know there'd be consequences for your actions, didn't you?\r\n
